permissions.source_labels: immutable18553 pure rows, newly authorized independent source classifiers only
permissions.source_valid: fixed30epoch checkpoint maximum Macro-F1 earliest strict improvement, then temperature from fixed grid minimum NLL
permissions.reference: forward only; no input fitting or labels
permissions.query: terminal metrics and error-overlap diagnostics only; no fitting, checkpoint, score or threshold selection
permissions.old_main_models: read-only historical predictions; no new main backbone/adapter updates

input.source_cache: existing reconstructed first5000 signed timestamp and2x1800 TAM
input.direction_order: 2x5000: sign(timestamp), identically zero second channel; zero timestamps padding convention inherited
input.direction_iat: same sign first channel; second log1p(1000*max(abs(t_i)-abs(t_i-1),0))/10 clipped[0,1], zero for first/padded/nonadjacent-valid packets
input.tam_cnn: log1p existing2x1800 counts; no learned input normalization

training.selection: max sourcevalid MacroF1 earliest strict improvement; each arm separate; no target scoring until ALL9 source trainings and their reload checks complete
training.initialization: from scratch per seed, same architecture same initial state across arms
training.shuffle: same epoch source permutations across arms per seed

architecture.blocks: Conv7 stride2 + GN8 + ELU + Conv3 + GN8 + ELU + MaxPool2 ceil
architecture.head: 102class linear
architecture.sharing: none with main encoder; independence of errors must be measured

metrics.frontier: diagnostic label-based exhaustive unique score prefixes NAR<=1%; reporting only; never deployed
metrics.fusion: fixed .5 calibrated frozen-source-head softmax + .5 calibrated view softmax, no tuning
metrics.historical: v9 PCA and smooth_balance, SHA checked, historical only; extra source training budget disclosed

gates.rule: each arm separately: source F1>=.60 all3 seeds; both slices 3seed mean commonwrong corrected>=.10, disagreement correction-vs-damage AUROC>=.65 and recovery@NAR1 gain vs historical v9 smooth>=.5pp. Main decision direction_order; secondary and control reported separately. No automatic adaptation or expansion even if passes.

budget.stop: no feedback-driven arms/retraining; errors fixed only with documented identical-config repair
